description: Held-out synthetic Bash corpus for the guard hooks (#10521). `main` is origin/main's frozen decision (block iff exit 2) measured by scripts/hooks/guard_main_parity.py in the bash_oracle probe; `{primary}`/`{worktree}` are the probe's synthetic checkouts. `over_refusals` enumerates every main ALLOW the branch refuses, with the #10521 ruling item that makes it a refusal.

rows.command:
cat <<'EOF'
git checkout feature
gh pr merge 5 --admin
EOF
git commit -m "docs: explain gh pr merge 5 --admin and git branch -D main"
if git diff --quiet; then echo clean; fi
for f in a b; do echo "$f"; done

cat <<'EOF'
git checkout feature

git checkout feature

EOF

if git diff --quiet; then echo clean; fi

if true; then gh pr merge --admin 5; fi

until true; do gh pr merge --admin 5; done

for i in 1; do gh pr merge --admin 5; done

case x in x) gh pr merge --admin 5;; esac
case x in x) git checkout feature;; esac
false(){ :; }; while false; do gh pr merge --squash 5; done
false(){ :; }; while false; do gh pr merge --admin 5; done

cd(){ :; }; cd wt && gh pr merge --squash 5
cd(){ :; }; cd wt && gh pr merge --admin 5

CDPATH=x cd wt && gh pr merge --admin 5

enable -n cd; cd wt && gh pr merge --squash 5
enable -n cd; cd wt && gh pr merge --admin 5

x

B

cat <<A /dev/fd/3 3<<B
x

B

x='; gh pr merge --squash 5'; bash <<EOF
echo $x
EOF
